senses.sense_definition: The act of setting someone or something free from the power, control, or influence of another.

examples.text: The <w>emancipation</w> of the serfs was a major turning point in the country's history.
She fought for the <w>emancipation</w> of women from traditional social constraints.

senses.sense_definition: The state of being liberated or freed from bondage, prejudice, or tyranny.

examples.text: The <w>emancipation</w> of the slaves changed the course of the nation forever.
He sought the <w>emancipation</w> of his mind from old superstitions and fears.
